title: A worker's brief lets it edit a kb/_self doc in its touches that an in-flight sibling also touches
goal: dispatch's in-flight siblings list does not tell a worker to leave a kb/_self/*.md doc of its own touches to a sibling, since docs shared by items are no overlap and the landing's rebase merges their hunks; a file only the sibling touches stays listed as one to leave alone
